_comment: Deterministic, windowed rules for the Variable Watcher. Separate from svd/rules.json (instantaneous register state) on purpose — see CLAUDE.md.
_note_disabled: Rules with "enabled": false are parsed but never evaluated. The two stackWatermark rules are disabled because RegionScan items are not sampled yet (WatchSampler has no byte-scan decode step), so no item can ever carry role=stackWatermark. Shipping them as active would promise detection that cannot happen. Re-enable them together with the RegionScan decode work — see docs/variable_watcher_review.md.
